verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for an analytics and feature-flag platform and its SDKs, CLI, and MCP server, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item documents a way to disable telemetry, usage tracking, or SDK event and exposure logging. The docs instead describe exposures being logged automatically, which is not an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
